items.question: Which mantras are declared garland-mantras according to syllable count?
premises: Mantras exceeding twenty syllables are garland-mantras.
items.inference: Therefore garland-mantras are those with more than twenty syllables.
uncertainties: The adjective viṃśatyarṇādhikā ends in ā while mantrāḥ is masculine plural, suggesting possible sandhi or editorial form.
items.plain_english: Mantras with more than twenty syllables are declared to be garland-mantras.
